name: WHO emergencies
summary: Ebola PHEIC in effect since May
state: WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Central Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026, and it remains in effect. No new PHEIC has been declared in the past 30 days as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Check NaTHNaC/TravelHealthPro advice before travelling to affected parts of Central and East Africa.
rubric_hit: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.

sources.title: UN News — WHO declares Ebola outbreak a PHEIC

why: A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) or 'pandemic emergency' is the top official global health alarm.
drivers: Outbreak spread, IHR Emergency Committee decisions.

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
